## Optional calculations
Data preparation and MCMC are controlled by explicit switches. Newly generated files are written to reproduced/.
RUN_PREPROCESS=False
RUN_FULL_FIT=False
import subprocess
if RUN_PREPROCESS:
    subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(ROOT/'scripts/prepare_lorimer_data.py'),'--execute-preprocess'],check=True)
if RUN_FULL_FIT:
    subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(ROOT/'src/lsr_sensitivity/run_lorimer2006_77_LN_11.py'),'--execute-fit','--ncores','300','--steps','2000'],check=True)
if not (RUN_PREPROCESS or RUN_FULL_FIT):
    print('Reading the supplied sensitivity result.')
